serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-vector-store-scanner
serverInfo.description: MCP server that probes vector-database endpoints (Weaviate, Qdrant, Chroma, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Redis, Postgres/pgvector) for unauthenticated exposure of embeddings and RAG data

tools.name: scan_endpoint
tools.description: Probe a vector-database (or vector-index-capable) endpoint for unauthenticated exposure — Weaviate, Qdrant, Chroma, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch (HTTP fingerprinting, escalating from instance info to collection/schema listing to actual stored data), Redis (RESP PING without AUTH), and Postgres/pgvector (wire-protocol SSLRequest + StartupMessage handshake, no real credentials sent). Read-only.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the endpoint to probe

port.description: Port to probe (defaults to the store type's conventional port)

type.description: Store type to probe for. 'auto' fingerprints the endpoint.

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List the vector-store types this scanner can fingerprint, and what unauthenticated-access checks it runs for each
